nodes.label: Release workflow (tag vX.Y.Z)
nodes.rationale: Triggered by pushing a v* tag after pnpm version:set X.Y.Z and a CHANGELOG entry. The package goes to npm and the app to a GitHub release with notes generated from the PRs since the last one. Two independent jobs: publish and app.

nodes.label: Publish parlour to npm job
nodes.rationale: Runs on macOS because the package's tests assume launchd and avfoundation, as CI does. Needs id-token: write for OIDC provenance. Tests and builds packages/parlour, then npm publish --provenance --access public.

nodes.label: Tag must match package.json version
nodes.rationale: A tag that does not match the version in packages/parlour/package.json would publish the wrong thing under the right name, which npm will not let anyone undo; the job fails and tells you to run pnpm version:set, commit, and tag that commit.

nodes.label: npm trusted publishing via OIDC
nodes.rationale: npm trusts this workflow through the OIDC token, so there is no NPM_TOKEN to rotate or leak; the package settings on npmjs.com name this repository and this file as the trusted publisher. Requires npm 11.5.1 or later, hence npm install -g npm@latest before publish. Provenance records which workflow and commit built the tarball.

nodes.label: Build the app and attach dmg to release job
nodes.rationale: contents: write to create the release and upload the .dmg. pnpm -C apps/desktop build is pnpm icons && tauri build, and Tauri runs pnpm build:ui first through beforeBuildCommand, so one step produces icons, frontend, binary, .app and .dmg. Uses softprops/action-gh-release with generate_release_notes and fail_on_unmatched_files.

nodes.label: Deliberate release follow-ups: unsigned app, no Homebrew tap
nodes.rationale: The app is unsigned and not notarised, so Gatekeeper asks the person to allow it on first open; signing needs an Apple Developer certificate in repository secrets and tauri-action or xcrun notarytool. No Homebrew tap: npm install -g parlour is the install path and the app is a plain .dmg download until a cask is worth maintaining.

hyperedges.label: Release process: version:set, hand-written CHANGELOG, vX.Y.Z tag, npm trusted publish, dmg on GitHub release
